title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer backoff during regional failover + load-shedding thrash
author: Ethan Reynolds
description:
Summary: During an incident on 2026-03-01 (SUP-2399) we observed the SLO enforcer thrashing when regional capacity dropped and regional failover kicked in. The enforcer entered a tight loop of tripping circuit breakers and immediately re-enabling regional routes, which caused rapid load-shedding bursts and downstream errors. This PR applies a targeted hotfix to stabilize backoff behavior, add per-region cooldowns, and reduce cascade risk while preserving fast failover for healthy traffic.

Motivation and context: Our previous backoff was a simple counter + fixed cooldown. Under multi-region failover load patterns that include short capacity blips, that logic can oscillate: a region trips, traffic is rerouted, the original region recovers quickly and is re-enabled, then trips again — this leads to continuous load-shedding and degraded overall throughput. The fix is urgent because several customers experienced elevated error rates and customer-facing timeouts during the incident.

What this change does: - Introduces exponential backoff with randomized jitter for SLO enforcer circuit breaker re-enables (min 10s, max 15m). - Adds a per-region cooldown window keyed by region+route to avoid global thrash. - Implements a short-term grace path that allows a small percentage of traffic to probe a recovered region without full route re-enable (probe rate configurable). - Caps concurrent re-enable attempts and serializes re-enable work per-region to prevent thundering re-enables. - Adds telemetry: enforcer_backoff_ms, enforcer_reenable_attempts, enforcer_region_probe_success/fail counts and a set of alertable SLI metrics. - Adds unit and integration tests exercising backoff/cooldown/probe scenarios and a small e2e chaos test that simulates region flaps. - Updates docs/operational runbook with recommended tuning knobs (min_backoff, max_backoff, probe_rate) and a playbook for manual override.

Implementation notes: - Core changes are in services/slo-enforcer/{controller,backoff_manager}.go and pkg/routing/circuit_breaker.go. - New metrics are wired via observability/metrics/registry.go and exposed on the enforcer metrics endpoint. - Feature is behind a runtime-config flag (enforcer.stable_backoff=true) and defaults enabled for production.

Checklist: - [x] Add stabilized backoff algorithm and per-region cooldown. - [x] Add telemetry and dashboards (observability/metrics). - [x] Add unit & integration tests. - [x] Run full CI and staging rollout (staged to eu-west then us-west). - [x] Coordinate with SRE for on-call runbook updates.

Commit summary: - stabilize: exponential backoff + jitter for enforcer re-enable - add: per-region cooldown manager and probe path - fix: serialize re-enable attempts to avoid bursts - test: unit/integration/e2e chaos tests for region flaps - doc: runbook + tuning guidance

Files changed (high level): - services/slo-enforcer/controller.go (core re-enable flow) - services/slo-enforcer/backoff_manager.go (new) - pkg/routing/circuit_breaker.go (logic adjustments) - observability/metrics/registry.go (metrics) - tests/slo-enforcer/* (unit + integration) - docs/runbooks/slo-enforcer.md - deploy/staging/featureflags.yaml

Testing and verification: - Added unit tests covering exponential backoff boundaries and jitter distribution. - Integration tests simulate region offline->recover sequences and validate no thrash across 30s windows. - Staging rollout (eu-west) observed stable enforcer behavior under synthetic region flaps; probe success rates matched expected probe_rate. - CI initially failed a flaky timing test; fixed by increasing test timing tolerances and adding a stable time source in the tests. Final CI run: all checks passed.

Risks and mitigations: - Risk: too-aggressive backoff could delay legitimate fast recovery. Mitigation: probe path allows a configurable small fraction of traffic to verify recovery quickly. - Risk: increased complexity in enforcer state. Mitigation: added observability + runbook and kept change minimal and behind flag for quick rollback.

Related: Incident SUP-2399, Linear ENG-9812, SRE runbook updates (SRE-4741).

review_comments: Priya Shah: Can we make the probe rate configurable per-customer? Response: added probe_rate override in runtime-config and documented default and per-customer override path.
Luca Martinez: Why cap max backoff at 15m? Response: We chose 15m to balance long-term suppression vs. recovery speed; documented rationale and added an env knob for emergency tuning.
Zoe Kim: Tests flaked in CI due to time jitter in unit test. Response: replaced real clock with monotonic fake clock in tests and increased tolerances. CI green after fix.
Marco Diaz: Are we emitting enough metrics to debug thrash? Response: added enforcer_reenable_attempts and region_probe_success/fail and a dashboard link in runbook.
Priya Shah: Approval after staging verification.
merge_outcome: Merged after approvals and successful staging canary. Post-merge: flag enabled in prod for 10% traffic for 30m, then rolled to 100%.
release_notes: Hotfix: Stabilize SLO enforcer backoff to prevent thrashing during regional failovers. Adds per-region cooldowns, exponential backoff with jitter, a probe path for fast verification, and new metrics. Backwards-compatible and configurable via runtime flags.
